actualOwnerAttestation.scope: Pure evidence reconciliation; caller separately proves archive bytes, PID/start/argv ownership, business/canonical/raw correctness and closed lifecycle

readPhaseBindings.timingScope: Phase min reservation start through max coordinator end is an observed lower bound, not exact bank lifetime. Per RPC coordinator end is after logical reply flush, before timing flush/consume. Elapsed includes ordered head wait and overlapping read intervals; retained capacity is source-enforced/runtime-attested, without independent consume timestamps.

config.readCreditPolicy: reserve+flush before arm; completed-unconsumed holds credit; consume after reply/timing flush
config.physicalAdmissionTimestampSemantics: monotonic return observation after the first nonnegative publication.offer; not an exact internal Aeron admission instant
config.maintenanceDispatchPolicy: drain pending while arrivals keep enqueuing/rejecting; exactprefix force/readback thenACK
config.scope: Finite openloop source; external canonical/leader/config proof required before any stability or capacity claim

ownerPollActual.waitPolicy: deadline-aware park up to 1ms; OS lateness is not bounded
